interpretation.range: Complete NY Monday 00:00-24:00 H1 range; 1.618 rails low-0.618*width and high+0.618*width.
interpretation.first_cross: Each side independently stops at its first complete H1 high>upper or low<lower. Equality is not a cross; any earlier H1 gap censors first-cross knowledge.
interpretation.mothers: Only the containing H1, UTC-aligned 4H built from exact four H1 children, and frozen UTC 12H candle are inspected.
interpretation.morphology: Open may equal a rail; close is strictly inside; whole body is bounded by both rails; target-side wick is strictly beyond its rail.
interpretation.trend: At each candidate close, project EMA20/50 from the prior contiguous completed frozen 12H EMA state plus that candidate close; require 50 samples. Lower wick requires EMA20>EMA50, upper wick requires EMA20<EMA50.
interpretation.selection: One earliest qualifying side per NY week; order by decision close, then 1H, 4H, 12H. Opposite sides tied at the same close and timeframe are left ambiguous.
interpretation.strict_vs_alternative: Primary trend arm stops at the side's first morphology-qualified timeframe even if trend direction mismatches. Any-TF arm is diagnostic and may promote to a higher timeframe; changed-week count is reported.
interpretation.scope: Signal morphology only. No trading, fills, PnL, or original-ledger overlap reconstruction.
